_readme: Each intent has example questions (patterns), the answer the bot gives, optional follow-up suggestions, and held-out test questions used only to measure accuracy. Edit answers freely; after changing patterns run: python3 chatbot/train.py

intents.answer: Hi! 👋 I'm Harshini — well, a little AI version of me. Ask me anything about my experience, skills, education or availability.
You're welcome! 😊 Anything else you'd like to know?
Thanks for stopping by! 👋 If you'd like to chat further, my email is harshini.g.official@gmail.com.

I'm a small AI model Harshini trained on her resume and her own answers to common interview questions, so everything I say is something she's approved. For anything I can't answer, you can email her directly at harshini.g.official@gmail.com.

intents.answer: You can ask me about my work experience, skills and tools, education, certifications, work rights, availability, preferred location and work setup, strengths, or what I enjoy outside work.

I'm Harshini, a data and analytics professional based in Sydney. I spent over two years as a Software Developer / Data Analyst at Carvewing Solutions, building Power BI and Amazon QuickSight dashboards, SQL reporting and Python automation for clients. I'm now studying a Master of Data Science and Innovation at UTS and looking for a part-time technical support or data role where I can keep learning and building.

intents.answer: Yes — SQL is one of my core skills. I used SQL on Amazon Redshift to analyse datasets and power reporting in QuickSight, and I'm comfortable with joins, aggregations and querying data for dashboards.
